technical_and_design_decisions: Development target is Java 17+ per the Spring 6.0 baseline mentioned in the specification.
Follow existing Spring XD code conventions, package structure, and patterns; no large-scale architectural rewrites.

For U2 (reliable HDFS writes), adopt a two-phase coordination pattern between the message bus and the HDFS sink, using bus-side acks only after the HDFS writer has flushed/synced and the file is closed/committed.
For U3 (partition function override), expose a module-level interface / SpEL expression that takes precedence over the default partition selector at runtime.
For U4 (multi-topic-partition consumption), use Kafka consumer group semantics to fan-in multiple partitions into a single in-memory queue/channel exposed to downstream modules.

For U5 (new DSL parser), build a stateful/context-aware parser (ANTLR-based) that can resolve forward references (e.g., MyStream defined later in the same script) and surface precise diagnostic errors back to the Flo UI.
For U6, restrict scope to a design document covering single-container/pod co-location patterns (Docker / Kubernetes / embedded server), without implementing runtime orchestration.
For U7, introduce a custom serialization that preserves ConfigurableConversionService configuration tuples, avoiding reset on deserialization.
For U8, use JMH (Java Microbenchmark Harness) for isolated, repeatable stream benchmarks with JMX on/off, and capture CPU, GC, and throughput metrics.
Include unit tests inside each feature activity; integration tests and documentation are tracked as separate activities.
Reuse the 'deploy-refactor-2' branch from U1 as the working baseline for that story.
assumptions: A single experienced Java/Spring developer is performing all the work; no coordination overhead, meetings, or onboarding.
Build environment, CI, and dependency infrastructure (Maven/Gradle, repositories, Kafka/HDFS test clusters) are already set up.

Spring XD source code is available locally and the developer is already familiar with the BaseDefinition, stream DSL, Kafka source, HDFS sink, and conversion service modules referenced by the stories.
U6 is design/documentation only, not implementation, consistent with the wording 'design and document the approach'.
Unit tests are bundled into each per-story activity; only cross-feature integration tests are itemized separately.
No production-level hardening (security review, full internationalization, accessibility, etc.) is included; estimates cover functional implementation, tests, and developer-facing documentation only.
Effort is measured in developer work-hours (focused, productive time) and excludes calendar time, idle time, or code review turnaround by other people.

Each user story can be developed largely independently and integrated at the end; some ordering dependencies (e.g., U1's refactor may touch shared code used by U5) are absorbed by small extra effort inside each activity.

activities.activity_description: Read all 8 user stories, inspect relevant existing Spring XD modules (BaseDefinition, HDFS sink, Kafka source, DSL parser, conversion service, JMX integration), and produce a short design note covering interfaces, ordering, and risks for the increment.

activities.activity_name: U1 - Refactor BaseDefinition: remove module list and reparse on demand
activities.activity_description: Work on the deploy-refactor-2 branch. Remove the eagerly loaded modules list from BaseDefinition, switch consumers to lazy reparse, and add/extend unit tests proving parity with the previous behavior for stream and job definitions.

activities.activity_name: U2 - Reliable HDFS writes for stream pipelines
activities.activity_description: Design and implement reliable HDFS commits: add a sync/flush + close protocol in the HDFS sink, coordinate acks with the message bus so that the bus only acknowledges after a successful HDFS commit, and add tests simulating partial-failure scenarios.

activities.activity_name: U3 - Partition function override in source/processor modules
activities.activity_description: Add a module-level extension point (interface and/or SpEL expression) that lets a source or processor module override the default partition selector, wire it through the messaging middleware integration, and add unit tests for custom and default paths.

activities.activity_name: U4 - Consume multiple topic-partitions into a single queue
activities.activity_description: Extend the Kafka source to subscribe to multiple topics/partitions, merge incoming records into a single internal channel/queue for downstream consumers, and add tests covering rebalancing and offset commit behavior.

activities.activity_name: U5 - New context-aware DSL parser for Flo UI
activities.activity_description: Design and implement a new DSL parser (ANTLR-based) that can parse stream/job definitions incrementally, resolve forward references like MyStream, and return structured, user-friendly errors to the Flo UI. Include grammar, parser, tests, and a small refactor of the existing parser endpoint.

activities.activity_name: U6 - Design and document single-container stream deployment
activities.activity_description: Produce a design document describing how to co-locate all modules of a stream inside a single container/pod (module lifecycle, IPC, packaging, deployment on Docker/Kubernetes with the embedded server), including trade-offs and an example manifest.

activities.activity_name: U7 - Preserve non-default ConfigurableConversionService tuples across deserialization
activities.activity_description: Audit the serialization path, introduce a serializer/deserializer pair that retains non-default ConfigurableConversionService tuples, remove the reset behavior, and add regression tests covering representative tuple types.

activities.activity_name: U8 - Benchmark stream with and without JMX
activities.activity_description: Set up JMH-based microbenchmarks and an end-to-end stream benchmark, run each scenario with JMX enabled and disabled, collect CPU/GC/throughput metrics, and document observed differences.

Build and run integration tests that exercise the combined behaviors introduced by U1-U8 (e.g., reliable HDFS writes with multi-partition sources, custom partitioners with the new DSL parser) and fix any cross-cutting defects.

Update developer and operator documentation (reference guide sections, Javadoc on new public APIs, and release notes) to reflect the new parser, reliable HDFS writes, partition override, multi-partition consumption, and deployment guidance.

activities.activity_name: Code review, defect fixing, and increment polish
activities.activity_description: Self-review the entire increment for consistency, style, and API quality; address findings from CI/static analysis; final cleanup and minor refactors before the increment is considered done.
